title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Printing and Distributing the Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for the Implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy"

Fa Fa [2018] No. 19

All High People's Courts of the provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on implementing the rural revitalization strategy, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy" and the "Rural Revitalization Strategic Plan (2018-2022)", and fully leverage the role of the people's courts in adjudication to provide strong judicial services and guarantees for implementing the rural revitalization strategy, our Court has formulated the "Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy". The Opinions are hereby issued to you. Please implement them earnestly in light of actual circumstances.

If any problems arise during implementation, promptly report them to our Court.

October 23, 2018

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy

To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on implementing the rural revitalization strategy, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy" (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions") and the "Rural Revitalization Strategic Plan (2018-2022)", and fully leverage the role of the people's courts in adjudication to provide strong judicial services and guarantees for implementing the rural revitalization strategy, the following opinions are proposed.

I. Effectively Enhance Political Awareness and Strengthen the Sense of Responsibility and Mission to Provide Judicial Services and Guarantees for Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy

1. Implementing the rural revitalization strategy is a major decision and deployment made at the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. Fully recognize that implementing the rural revitalization strategy is a major historical task for securing a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and for building a modern socialist country in all respects, and is of great significance for resolving the contradiction between the people's ever-growing needs for a better life and unbalanced and inadequate development, achieving the Two Centenary Goals, and realizing common prosperity for all the people. Profoundly understand General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on implementing the rural revitalization strategy, the spirit of the 19th National Congress and the "Opinions", consciously assume the sacred duties and important mission of the people's courts, effectively enhance the consciousness and initiative in providing judicial services and guarantees for implementing the rural revitalization strategy, and fully leverage the role of the people's courts in serving and guaranteeing the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy.

2. Implementing the rural revitalization strategy is a theoretical and policy innovation of the Party's work on agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, under the strong leadership of the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, significant achievements have been made in the work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, and rich experience has been accumulated. The "Opinions" clearly define the guiding ideology, objectives, tasks, basic principles, and work priorities of the rural revitalization strategy, in response to the reality that the principal contradiction facing Chinese society has evolved into the contradiction between unbalanced and inadequate development and the people's ever-growing needs for a better life, and that the problem of unbalanced and inadequate development is most prominent in rural areas. People's courts at all levels shall accurately grasp the spirit of the "Opinions" and thoroughly implement the Party's theories and work policies on agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era in judicial adjudication and enforcement work.

3. Implementing the rural revitalization strategy is the overarching task of work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era. Issues concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers are fundamental to the national economy and people's livelihood. Rural areas have unique functions in ensuring food security, supplying agricultural products, providing ecological barriers, and inheriting traditional culture, and occupy an irreplaceable important position in comprehensive economic and social development. The "Opinions" provide a top-level design for implementing the rural revitalization strategy, prioritize the development of agriculture and rural areas as a major principle in modernization, and regard the revitalization of rural areas as a major task for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. This has very important guiding significance for doing a good job in the work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era. People's courts at all levels shall firmly grasp the rural revitalization strategy as the overarching task of work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era, lawfully and properly handle various conflicts and disputes arising during the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy, promote the comprehensive upgrading of agriculture, overall progress of rural areas, and all-round development of farmers, and write a brilliant page of people's justice in the new chapter of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers.

II. Accurately Grasp the Guiding Ideology and Basic Principles, and Continuously Advance the Work of Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy to Deeper Levels

4. People's courts at all levels shall take Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as their guide, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee. Firmly establish a new development concept, and promote high-quality development of agriculture and rural areas. Closely revolve around the overall plan for promoting the five-sphere integrated plan and the strategic layout for promoting the four-pronged comprehensive strategy, insist on regarding the conduct of judicial adjudication concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, and the provision of services and guarantees for implementing the rural revitalization strategy as the top priority of the people's courts' work, adhere to prioritizing the development of agriculture and rural areas, and increase the supply of judicial resources in rural areas. In accordance with the general requirements of thriving businesses, ecological livability, civilized rural etiquette, effective governance, and prosperous lives, assist in modernizing the rural governance system and governance capacity, promote the modernization of agriculture and rural areas and the integrated development of urban and rural areas, and adhere to the path of socialist rural revitalization with Chinese characteristics. Through leveraging the adjudication function of the people's courts, promote the full realization of the goals of "strong agriculture, beautiful rural areas, prosperous farmers", making agriculture a promising industry, farmers an attractive profession, and rural areas a beautiful homeland for living and working in contentment.

5. The people's courts shall adhere to the following basic principles in serving and guaranteeing the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy. Adhere to serving and guaranteeing the priority development of agriculture and rural areas, increase the investment of judicial resources in rural areas, and improve the coverage and convenience of judicial services in rural areas; adhere to the general work tone of seeking progress while maintaining stability, focus on maintaining the stability of the basic rural system, and lawfully support reform pilot work in rural pilot areas; adhere to lawfully protecting the principal status of farmers, lawfully protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the vast number of farmers, respect farmers' wishes, and mobilize the initiative, enthusiasm, and creativity of hundreds of millions of farmers; adhere to serving the comprehensive revitalization of rural areas, accurately grasp the scientific connotation of rural revitalization, and actively serve and guarantee rural economic construction, political construction, cultural construction, social construction, and ecological civilization construction; adhere to promoting the integrated development of urban and rural areas, lawfully break down urban-rural trade barriers, and promote the formation of a new type of industrial-agricultural and urban-rural relationship characterized by mutual promotion, urban-rural complementarity, comprehensive integration, and common prosperity; adhere to promoting harmony between humanity and nature, strictly uphold the red line of ecological protection, and assist in the green development of rural areas; adhere to focusing on adjudication and adapting measures to local conditions, carry out service and guarantee work based on leveraging the adjudication function, adopt measures according to local conditions, prescribe the right remedy for the case, avoid a one-size-fits-all approach, avoid formalism, work diligently and persistently for long-term results.

III. Assist Rural Reform and Development, and Consolidate the Foundation for the Modernization of Agriculture and Rural Areas

6. Lawfully and properly hear cases concerning rural land contracting, and thoroughly implement the central government's reform policy of "separating the three rights" of contracted land. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of agricultural business entities such as farmer cooperatives and family farms, safeguard the rural land collective ownership and the two-tier management system combining centralized and decentralized operations based on household contract management on a collective ownership basis, ensure that land contract relations remain stable and unchanged for a long time, and promote the improvement of the basic rural operation system. In accordance with the requirements of "implementing collective ownership, stabilizing farmers' contract rights, and liberalizing land management rights", protect the lawful and orderly transfer of land management rights of rural contracted land. In accordance with the Property Law, the Rural Land Contract Law, and other provisions, protect the legal rights of farmers to possess, use, and benefit from contracted land. On the basis of fully respecting the true wishes of farmers, reasonably and orderly promote the marketization, intensification, organization, and scaling up of agriculture.

7. Lawfully and in accordance with regulations handle disputes such as those concerning the "separation of three rights" of rural homestead land and the entry of collectively operated construction land into the market, to safeguard the reform of the rural land system. On the basis of protecting farmers' qualification rights to homestead land and farmers' property rights to houses, lawfully protect the transfer of use rights of homestead land and rural collective construction land, and the construction of rural houses, agricultural facilities, and leisure tourism facilities that conform to the overall land use plan, and strongly support reform pilot areas in carrying out pilot reforms of the rural land system. For acts of illegally or in violation of regulations buying or selling homestead land, violating land use controls, or where industrial and commercial enterprises and urban residents go to the countryside to use rural homestead land to build villas and private clubs, lawfully declare them invalid.

8. Lawfully and properly hear cases concerning the protection of arable land, and safeguard national food security. Implement the special protection system for permanent basic farmland, lawfully and in accordance with regulations strictly deal with acts of occupying arable land, especially permanent basic farmland, illegally or in violation of regulations constructing non-agricultural facilities, changing the nature and use of land, and if crimes are suspected, pursue criminal liability according to law. Safeguard and support administrative organs in exercising their powers according to law, and ensure the achievement of the goal of arable land protection of "use control, economical utilization, strict management". Adhere to the concept of restorative justice, and for acts of polluting or destroying arable land, or converting basic farmland to other uses, lawfully order the responsible persons to take restorative remedial measures such as pollution control and reclamation, and firmly uphold the red line of arable land.

9. Lawfully and properly hear cases concerning rural infrastructure construction and basic public services, and promote the upgrading of infrastructure and comprehensive development of basic public services. Strengthen the adjudication of cases concerning agricultural infrastructure construction projects, lawfully severely crack down on criminal acts that destroy farmland water conservancy projects, flood control projects, and other construction projects, strengthen the protection of the interests of investors in construction projects such as small-scale farmland water conservancy facilities and comprehensive management of small watersheds, and promote the construction and development of rural infrastructure. Lawfully and properly handle cases concerning medical insurance, endowment insurance, and other disputes in rural areas, and promote the construction of the rural social security system.

10. Lawfully crack down on and sanction criminal and illegal acts of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard goods, and guarantee the implementation of the strategy of revitalizing agriculture through quality. Lawfully punish criminal and illegal acts such as producing and selling fake seeds, fake fertilizers, fake pesticides, and other agricultural production materials that do not meet national mandatory technical standards or safety standards, and counterfeit and substandard goods, protect the order of agricultural production and management, and promote the transformation of agricultural products from quantity to quality, and agriculture from output-oriented to quality-oriented. Maintain market order, guide rural producers and operators to establish a philosophy of quality first and honest operation.

11. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of various market entities such as rural investors, and stimulate the vitality of market entities. Lawfully protect diversified forms of association and cooperation among farmers, strengthen the protection of new-type rural market entities such as farmer professional cooperatives and professional service companies, and promote the organic integration of small farmers and modern agricultural development. Lawfully protect the rights and interests of rural investors, guide social funds to flow to rural areas, and make up for the funding shortfall facing rural development. For the realization forms and operating mechanisms of the new rural collective economy formed by transforming resources into assets, capital into shares, and farmers into shareholders, lawfully and in accordance with regulations provide protection.

12. Lawfully and properly hear cases concerning the protection of rural property rights and various contract disputes, and consolidate the market foundation for a good business environment in rural areas. Strengthen the protection of non-public property rights in rural areas, and stimulate the initiative and creativity of property owners. Lawfully protect the two-way flow of production factors such as talent, land, and capital, and commodity services between urban and rural areas, and promote the integrated development of urban and rural areas. In judicial adjudication, promote the spirit of abiding by contracts and honest and trustworthy contractual obligations, give play to the decisive role of the market in the allocation of rural resources, and actively promote the formation of a national unified, urban-rural integrated production factor market, product service market, labor market, and financial market.

13. Lawfully protect intellectual property rights in agriculture and rural areas, and assist in the transformation and upgrading of agriculture. Further strengthen the adjudication of intellectual property cases involving agriculture, promote the transformation of agricultural scientific and technological achievements, promote the transformation and upgrading of the rural economy towards innovation-driven development, and make up for the shortcomings in science and technology facing the development of agriculture and rural areas. Severely crack down on crimes against intellectual property rights in agriculture, strictly and lawfully try cases of infringement of intellectual property rights and breach of contract in agriculture, and strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in agriculture, especially major agricultural scientific and technological achievements and new plant varieties with independent intellectual property rights. Strengthen the protection of agricultural product trademarks, geographical indications or collective trademarks, certification trademarks, and promote the brand building of agricultural products. Improve the level of judicial protection for intangible cultural heritage, and promote the protection and development of intangible cultural heritage.

14. Lawfully regulate various types of financial activities, and promote financial services to the real economy in rural areas. Lawfully protect fund mutual assistance and other transaction models that are conducive to reducing transaction costs, suitable for farmers' needs, and in compliance with legal provisions, promote the reform of the rural financial system, guide more financial resources to be allocated to key areas and weak links in rural economic and social development, and assist in achieving thriving rural industries and prosperous lives for farmers. Severely crack down on criminal acts such as "routine loan" fraud, strictly restrict usury according to law, strengthen the review of acts that implicitly charge high interest, and regulate and guide the healthy development of private lending. Lawfully protect agricultural credit and inclusive finance, and promote the tilt of financial resources towards the "three rural issues" (agriculture, rural areas, and farmers).

15. Lawfully and properly handle foreign-related cases in the "three rural issues" field, and actively support agriculture in going global. Strengthen the adjudication of civil and commercial cases in the fields of international trade in agricultural products, trade in agricultural services, and international agricultural investment and financing. Increase efforts to crack down on criminal acts such as smuggling of new plant varieties and other agricultural products and trade in new plant varieties, and maintain the order of the agricultural import and export market. Strengthen judicial exchanges and judicial cooperation with countries and regions along the Belt and Road, and continuously improve judicial policies to serve and guarantee agricultural product trade and international agricultural investment and financing.

16. Lawfully punish crimes that disrupt the rural economic order, and maintain a safe and orderly production environment. Strengthen the punishment of crimes involving illegal fundraising in the "three rural issues" field, carry out propaganda and education on preventing illegal fundraising through various forms in rural areas, improve the risk prevention awareness of rural residents, and maintain rural financial order. Lawfully punish crimes of liability for production safety accidents, strictly pursue the criminal liability of relevant responsible persons according to law, and effectively safeguard the safety of rural production and operation, construction safety, and educational facilities safety.

17. Lawfully strengthen the enforcement of cases involving agriculture, rural areas and farmers, and promptly realize the legal rights of farmers. For cases involving people's livelihood in rural areas, prioritize case filing, enforcement, and distribution of enforcement funds. Make good use of the enforcement network inquiry and control system to solve the difficulties of locating persons and property in cases involving agriculture, rural areas and farmers. Make good use of the joint disciplinary system for persons subject to enforcement for dishonesty to effectively deter and prevent evasion and avoidance of enforcement. Make good use of the online judicial auction platform to solve the difficulties in realizing the property of the person subject to enforcement, especially agricultural products and fresh goods. Rely on the four-level court enforcement command center to achieve effective coordination of enforcement work and form a joint force to overcome the difficulties in enforcing cases involving agriculture, rural areas and farmers. Actively carry out special activities to clear up accumulated enforcement cases involving agriculture, rural areas and farmers, and focus on solving enforcement problems that farmers urgently need to be resolved.

IV. Strengthen Environmental Resource Protection, and Assist in the Construction of Rural Ecological Civilization

18. Accurately understand and grasp the dialectical relationship between green development and rural revitalization, and between ecological environmental protection and rural economic development. Firmly establish and practice the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, protect and promote the development of the rural tourism industry. Advocate green lifestyles, and promote continuous improvement of the living environment in rural areas. In accordance with the general requirements of building ecological and livable rural areas, assist in the transformation of agricultural production methods from resource-intensive to energy-saving and emission-reducing green development, and achieve a virtuous cycle of social production.

19. Lawfully and properly hear civil cases concerning environmental resources, and guide the establishment of a good environmental protection concept. Lawfully and properly handle cases of environmental torts involving rural soil and water pollution, accurately identify the responsible parties, strictly pursue civil liability, explore the application of punitive damages in cases of environmental pollution and ecological damage disputes, and actively create a legal environment where people dare not pollute and are unwilling to pollute. Actively and prudently handle rural ecological compensation cases, and promote the formation of a working mechanism where ecological damage is compensated by the perpetrator, beneficiaries pay, and protectors receive compensation. Lawfully and properly handle contract disputes and tort disputes involving personal and property damage arising from the development of rural ecotourism, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties involved, and promote the supply of agricultural ecological products and services.

20. Lawfully and properly hear administrative cases concerning environmental resources, and promote the legalization and standardization of environmental administrative law enforcement. Lawfully hear administrative cases involving the confirmation of rights to rural land, forests, mountains, grasslands, beaches, etc., and strengthen the protection of rural natural resources. Lawfully and properly handle administrative cases related to ecological migration and ecological compensation in ecological function areas, and promote the implementation of the ecological protection compensation mechanism. Lawfully and properly hear administrative cases arising from rural environmental supervision, pollutant discharge permits, agricultural non-point source pollution control, grazing bans and rotational grazing, and the collection of taxes and fees such as environmental protection taxes, and support and supervise the environmental resource protection administrative authorities in performing their duties according to law.

21. Lawfully and properly hear environmental public interest litigation cases, ecological environmental damage compensation cases, and other new types of environmental resource cases. Timely accept and hear environmental civil public interest litigation cases brought by social organizations that meet the statutory conditions, as well as rural environmental civil, administrative public interest litigation cases and criminal附带 civil public interest litigation cases brought by procuratorial organs, and continuously improve the trial procedures and supporting mechanisms for environmental public interest litigation cases. Lawfully and properly hear cases concerning compensation for ecological environmental damage in rural areas brought by statutory authorities, and pursue the ecological environmental damage compensation liability of the responsible parties.

22. Lawfully and properly hear criminal cases of polluting the rural environment and destroying rural ecology. Lawfully severely punish crimes of dereliction of duty in environmental supervision and major safety liability accidents that cause serious consequences of environmental pollution and ecological damage, and build a judicial protection barrier for the safety of the rural ecological environment. In the trial of criminal cases involving environmental resources, explore the inclusion of the ecological value loss of environmental resources as a circumstance for conviction and sentencing. For farmers and rural collective economic organizations that have suffered damage due to illegal and criminal acts of polluting the environment and destroying resources, lawfully protect their right to claim damages.

23. Optimize collaborative adjudication mechanisms, and enhance the level of judicial service and guarantee for green development in rural areas. Strengthen the allocation of specialized environmental resource adjudication institutions and the training of adjudication personnel. Establish a coordination and linkage mechanism with public security, procuratorial, and environmental resource protection authorities, actively leverage the functions and roles of grassroots people's mediation committees, and promote the establishment of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for rural environmental resource disputes, achieving all-round protection of rural natural ecosystems.

V. Promote Core Socialist Values, and Foster the Construction of Civilized, Harmonious, and Safe Rural Areas

24. Vigorously promote social virtues, and inherit, develop, and enhance outstanding traditional rural culture. Lawfully and properly handle neighborhood disputes in rural areas, promote the rural neighborhood virtues of mutual assistance and moral cultivation, and maintain the emotional and moral bonds established in acquaintance societies based on blood, kinship, clan, and geographical ties. Pay attention to distinguishing local customs and ethnic habits, and through judicial adjudication, guide rural areas to abandon undesirable practices such as exorbitant bride prices, interference in freedom of marriage, and failure to support the elderly. Through judicial adjudication, lawfully supervise administrative organs in lawfully exercising their powers in the construction of public culture in rural areas and actions to change outdated habits, and promote the formation of a new atmosphere of civilized rural etiquette.

25. Advance the reform of the methods and working mechanisms for family adjudication to promote the construction of harmonious families in rural areas. For marriages in crisis, treatment shall be strengthened, family virtues shall be vigorously promoted, and efforts shall be focused on maintaining family stability. For marriages where the emotional bond has truly broken down, attention shall be paid to defusing family conflicts and preventing the occurrence of vicious injury incidents arising from family disputes. Guide family members to establish behavioral norms, promote fine traditional morals, and cultivate family virtues. Actively consolidate the property system and emotional foundation conducive to family stability, and focus on protecting the legitimate rights and interests of minors, women, and the elderly.

26. Continuously deepen the special campaign to combat organized crime and root out local mafia, enhancing the sense of safety and well-being of rural residents. Resolutely, in accordance with the law, strictly and swiftly punish: mafia-like gangs that seize control of rural grassroots political power, manipulate and disrupt rural grassroots elections, monopolize rural resources, and embezzle collective assets; "village bullies" and other mafia-like gangs that use family or clan power to tyrannize the countryside, dominate an area, and oppress and harm the people; mafia-like gangs in rural areas that force projects, engage in malicious bidding, illegally occupy land, and indiscriminately exploit resources in industries and fields such as land acquisition, land leasing, demolition, engineering project construction, transportation, mineral resources, and fishing; "market bullies" and "trade bullies" and other mafia-like gangs in rural commercial markets and wholesale markets that dominate the market, force buying and selling, and collect protection money; mafia-like gangs in rural areas that manipulate and operate illegal and criminal activities such as prostitution, gambling, and drug abuse, as well as illegal high-interest lending, violent debt collection, interference in civil disputes, and acting as "underground law enforcement teams." Resolutely, in accordance with the law, strictly and swiftly punish the "protective umbrellas" of mafia-like gangs.

27. Punish crimes that endanger rural social security in accordance with the law, and promote the construction of "law-based villages" and "safe villages." Implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity to promote rural harmony and stability. Fairly and properly adjudicate criminal cases arising from disputes over love and marriage, neighborhood disputes, land ownership disputes, and land acquisition and demolition disputes, and carry out mediation work to strive for case resolution and ending of disputes. Fully respect rural customs and living habits that conform to socialist core values, and prudently adjudicate criminal cases arising from farmers' daily production and life. Organically combine lawful punishment with systematic governance, comprehensive governance, and source governance to prevent various types of rural crimes at their source and maintain social security and stability in the vast rural areas.

28. Increase joint credit punishment efforts against dishonest judgment debtors, and establish a value orientation of rewarding honesty and punishing dishonesty in the enforcement of agricultural-related cases. Emphasize the important role of grassroots workers such as village cadres, judicial assistants, and people's mediators, strengthen enforcement settlement, enhance neighborhood harmony, and promote rural stability. Effectively connect the enforcement process with the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for rural social conflicts, and with the construction of village rules and folk conventions and good customs and virtues, continuously advance the construction of socialist core values in rural areas.

VI. Uphold the Concept of Combining Autonomy, Rule of Law, and Rule of Virtue to Modernize the Rural Governance System and Governance Capacity

29. Accurately grasp the relationship between villager autonomy and state rule of law, actively build a bridge between the rule of law and the rule of virtue, and promote the improvement of a governance system combining rural autonomy, rule of law, and rule of virtue. Fully protect villagers' autonomy rights, adhere to the position of farmers as the main body in the rural revitalization strategy, and prudently grasp the boundary between villager autonomy and state rule of law. While implementing autonomy and rule of law, focus on leveraging the role of rule of virtue. Adhere to embedding rule of virtue within the rule of law, using the rule of law to promote rule of virtue, allowing flexible morality to be forcefully promoted, and making morality and law complement each other. By giving full play to the moral guidance and behavioral norm-setting role of judicial adjudication, promote the mutual reinforcement of a state of ceremonies and fine traditional culture with the construction of a rule-of-law society. Crack down on "micro-corruption" and "petty corruption" at the rural grassroots level in accordance with the law, actively participate in grassroots governance, and help achieve the goal of effective rural governance.

30. Adhere to the policy of separation of government from religion, and strictly prohibit religious interference in the exercise of state judicial functions. Prohibit inviting religious figures to use the religious beliefs of believers to handle rural conflicts and disputes. Correctly grasp the boundary between religious doctrine and ethnic customs and social morals, and punish in accordance with the law acts that, under the guise of religion, infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of the broad masses of religious believers and rural residents, including the rights to freedom of marriage, personal freedom, personal dignity, freedom to believe or not believe in religion, and property rights. Severely crack down on crimes involving the organization and use of cult organizations. Through circuit trials, explanation of the law through cases, and other methods, educate and guide the broad masses of religious believers to correctly understand and handle the relationship between national law and religious precepts, and enhance their concept of the rule of law.

31. Establish and improve a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for agricultural-related disputes, and enhance the overall joint force in preventing and resolving conflicts and disputes. Strengthen communication and cooperation between people's courts and political power organizations and mass autonomous organizations such as rural agricultural management departments, judicial administrative departments, and women's federations. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism that organically links and coordinates rural mediation, arbitration, administrative adjudication, administrative reconsideration, and judicial litigation. Promote the establishment of comprehensive service platforms such as "one-stop processing" and "one-stop service," inherit and develop the "Fengqiao experience," and actively promote the "Xunwu experience." Establish and improve a mediation and resolution mechanism for disputes over rural land contract and management rights that combines rural mediation, county/city arbitration, and judicial guarantee. Strengthen communication and coordination with relevant administrative authorities in areas such as agriculture, rural transportation, environment, market supervision, and culture, enhance the synergy between judicial and administrative law enforcement, continuously improve the rural legal public service system, and form a joint force for the construction of the rule of law in rural areas.

32. Strengthen grassroots infrastructure and effectively carry out work in people's courts. Adhere to the principles of "three orientations" (orienting towards the countryside, towards the grassroots, and towards the masses) and "two conveniences" (convenience for the masses to litigate and convenience for the people's courts to adjudicate), give full play to the advantages of people's courts being close to villages and the masses, and earnestly carry out the work of people's courts. Strengthen the management of people's courts, establish and improve the evaluation system for the quality and efficiency of case adjudication and the comprehensive supervision and evaluation system for courts. Strengthen the construction of people's courts, focus on solving problems such as personnel allocation, rank and treatment, security, funding, and material equipment for rural people's courts, and ensure the smooth development of the basic grassroots work of people's courts. Uphold and improve the circuit trial system of people's courts, and continuously improve the effectiveness and level of circuit trials.

33. Thoroughly implement the People's Assessors Law, and continuously improve the people's assessor system. Adhere to the system of randomly selecting candidates for people's assessors and randomly determining people's assessors, give full play to the role of people's assessors in participating in trials, promote judicial democracy, promote judicial fairness, and achieve the organic unity of professional judicial judgment and the common sense of ordinary people. Actively fulfill the obligations of guiding and reminding people's assessors, but shall not hinder the independent judgment of assessors on cases. Vigorously publicize the people's assessor system, focus on improving the level of guarantee for the performance of duties of people's assessors, and promote the formation of a good situation where various functional departments coordinate and cooperate, the masses understand and support, and people's assessors actively and orderly participate in trials.

34. Strengthen the publicity and education of the rule of law in rural areas, and enhance the awareness of rural autonomous organizations and farmers to respect, learn, abide by, and apply the law. Deeply explore case resources related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, and strengthen rural rule-of-law publicity through methods such as explaining the law with cases. Actively carry out activities such as rule-of-law publicity and court trials entering villages and schools. For cases with the effect of "adjudicating one case, educating a whole area," actively conduct circuit trials. Actively cooperate with news media such as radio and television stations, publicize the rule of law through legal programs and other methods, and use methods that the masses enjoy and language that is easy to understand, so that the vast rural masses can receive education on the rule of law.

VII. Strengthen Protection of Rights and Interests to Meet the Growing Needs of Farmers for a Better Life

35. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmers in accordance with the law, and give play to the main role of farmers in rural revitalization. Take the protection of farmers' rights as the starting point and goal, correctly handle the rights and obligations among various entities such as rural collective economic organizations, rural contractual households, and farmers, and maintain rural production and operation order. Adhere to the principles of unshakable collective ownership by farmers, non-loss of collective assets, and non-infringement of farmers' rights, and properly handle disputes arising from the reform of the rural collective property rights system in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate cases of illegal interception and deduction of farmers' contract income in accordance with the law, and protect farmers' contractual operation income. By strengthening the judicial protection of farmers' rights, mobilize the enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity of the broad masses of farmers.

36. Protect the personal rights of farmers in accordance with the law, and increase the intensity of judicial protection of human rights in rural areas. Punish in accordance with the law acts that infringe upon farmers' personal freedom and personal dignity for the purpose of debt collection. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts such as illegal detention by illegal employers or individuals, forcing migrant workers to engage in dangerous and heavy labor, illegally buying and using abducted children for labor or begging. Properly adjudicate cases of food and drug safety disputes in rural areas in accordance with the law, and protect farmers' right to health. Punish in accordance with the law criminal acts such as abuse and abandonment, and focus on protecting the legitimate rights and interests of empty-nest elderly and left-behind children in rural areas. Urge guardians of minors to fulfill their obligation to ensure that school-age adolescents receive compulsory education in accordance with the law, and protect the right to education of rural children.

37. Properly handle the issue of membership qualifications of rural collective economic organizations in accordance with the law, and protect farmers' basic property rights. Fully recognize the importance of membership qualifications in rural collective economic organizations for farmers' basic property rights such as land contractual management rights, rights to use homesteads, and rights to distribute collective income. Prudently handle the relationship between respecting villagers' autonomy and protecting farmers' basic property rights, and prevent simply using villagers' autonomy as a reason to deprive villagers of their basic property rights. Continuously strengthen communication and cooperation with rural agricultural management departments, land management departments, and other units, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of rural women who marry out and men who marry into the family in accordance with the law and regulations.

38. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers in accordance with the law, and give play to the positive role of migrant workers in rural revitalization. Strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers working in cities in terms of working conditions, labor remuneration, work-related injury insurance, medical insurance, and old-age insurance. Protect in accordance with the law the land contractual management rights, rights to use homesteads, rights to distribute collective income, and the legitimate rights and interests of returning migrant workers who start businesses for those who have settled in cities. Focus on protecting the right to education, personal safety, and personal dignity of children of migrant workers living in cities, so that migrant workers can both enter and settle down in cities and return to villages with peace of mind.

39. Properly adjudicate disputes over rural collective land expropriation, farmers' house demolition and resettlement compensation in accordance with the law, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of land-expropriated farmers. In accordance with the purposes and objectives of land expropriation stipulated by law, consider as important factors in determining the legality of the expropriation act whether the principle of equal compensation for equal land has been followed, whether reasonable compensation has been paid promptly and in full to rural collective economic organizations and farmers, whether the employment, housing, and social security of the land-expropriated farmers have been properly addressed, and whether it is conducive to promoting agricultural and rural development, maintaining rural social stability and harmony, and strengthening rural ecological civilization construction.

40. Punish crimes that infringe upon farmers' rights and interests in accordance with the law, and protect the personal and property safety of rural residents. Severely punish in accordance with the law crimes such as rape, indecency, abduction, buying, and fraud targeting left-behind elderly, women, and children in rural areas. Actively explore linkage mechanisms between judicial protection for the elderly, women, and children and administrative, family, school, and social protection, and promote pilot work on linkage mechanisms. Properly handle cases such as campus bullying in accordance with the law, guide the healthy growth of rural youth through judicial adjudication and rule-of-law publicity and education, and urge schools to strengthen management. Actively participate in the special work of combating new types of telecommunications and cyber fraud, and focus on carrying out anti-telecommunications fraud publicity activities entering villages and grassroots levels to effectively prevent and reduce the occurrence of telecommunications fraud cases.

41. Promote the construction of smart courts and judicial transparency, and enhance the sense of access to fair justice for rural residents. Build smart courts and online judicial communities, covering functional modules such as online case filing, online petitions, progress inquiry, material transfer, and online trials for agricultural-related cases. Improve online judicial services such as "one-click claim settlement" for road traffic accident disputes, so that "information runs more errands and farmers run fewer errands." Adhere to the system of live streaming trials and online publication of judgment documents to facilitate rural residents to watch trials and review documents, achieving visible fair justice.

42. Combine the Party's mass line with judicial specialization, and continuously meet the growing demands of farmers for social fairness and justice. Adopt methods such as "the masses reason, judges explain the law," combining the mass line and mass work methods with judicial specialization, to achieve social fairness and justice in ways that rural residents can understand and feel. Respect village rules and folk customs that do not violate mandatory legal provisions, and properly handle the application of customs in civil adjudication. Improve the online enforcement complaint platform of people's courts, and expand channels for rural residents to express their demands.

43. Improve judicial measures for serving the people, benefiting the people, and facilitating the people, and continuously enhance the ability of judicial services for agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Implement work methods such as door-to-door case filing, telephone case filing, and appointment case filing, and smooth the "last mile" of judicial convenience. In remote areas with inconvenient transportation and sparse population, carry out legal consultation, writing of litigation documents, and dispute mediation on the spot, and file cases, hold trials, mediate, and render judgments on the spot, enhancing the availability and accessibility of litigation services. Deeply promote the construction of a working mechanism for separating complex cases from simple ones and for mediation and expedited adjudication, open green channels for cases involving the protection of farmers' rights, and improve the mechanism for separating complex and simple cases. Strengthen the work of clarification and provide guidance and assistance to rural residents in litigation.

44. Actively assist in targeted poverty alleviation and ensure victory in the battle against poverty. Winning the battle against poverty is a priority task in implementing the rural revitalization strategy. Properly adjudicate rural labor dispute cases in accordance with the law, and for cases such as arrears of migrant workers' wages and labor remuneration, achieve rapid case filing, rapid adjudication, and rapid enforcement, helping the impoverished population with labor ability to escape poverty and become prosperous through hard work. Properly adjudicate cases related to poverty alleviation relocation, as well as disputes over medical insurance, social security, and social relief for the impoverished population, and protect the stability of their lives. Adjudicate cases involving misappropriation and embezzlement of poverty alleviation funds in accordance with the law, and severely punish corruption in the field of poverty alleviation.

45. Strengthen judicial assistance in rural areas and protect the basic rights of disadvantaged groups. Improve the specific conditions and standards for deferring, reducing, or exempting litigation costs for parties in economic difficulty. For parties who pursue child support, spousal support, parental support, personal injury compensation, and labor remuneration and are genuinely in economic difficulty, take measures to defer, reduce, or exempt litigation costs in accordance with the law. Increase the intensity of criminal judicial assistance, and provide timely judicial assistance to victims and their relatives who are in living difficulty in accordance with the law. Do a good job in enforcement judicial assistance, refine assistance standards, promote openness in assistance, and ensure that judicial assistance funds are accurately distributed to the hands of farmers who meet the assistance conditions.
